Unclogs pores: Exfoliates the skin gently, clearing blocked pores and preventing breakouts.
Hydrates and nourishes: Restores moisture to the skin, keeping it soft and hydrated.

13f068a6-c606-4e5b-bc26-7e2c047b6e39.name: Cold Plasma
13f068a6-c606-4e5b-bc26-7e2c047b6e39.description:
Short Description
Cold Plasma is a high-tech skincare treatment that uses low-temperature, ionized gas (plasma) to improve skin health. This treatment is designed to stimulate skin cells, promote healing, and enhance the absorption of other active ingredients in skincare products. The technology can be used for a variety of skin concerns, including signs of aging, inflammation, and uneven texture.

What It Does & Benefits
Improves Skin Texture: Helps smooth the skin by promoting collagen production and increasing cell turnover.
Reduces Fine Lines & Wrinkles: Stimulates the skin’s natural repair process, which can reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.
Balances Skin Tone: Helps even out skin tone and texture by targeting pigmentation and boosting the skin’s regeneration process.
Hydrates & Firms Skin: Boosts skin hydration and can improve firmness and elasticity by enhancing the absorption of moisture.
Soothes & Calms the Skin: The cold plasma technology has anti-inflammatory properties, making it beneficial for those with sensitive or irritated skin.

Instructions
Cleanse the Skin: Start with a clean face by removing makeup, dirt, and oils.
Apply Serum (Optional): If using with a serum, apply it to your face before the Cold Plasma device for enhanced absorption.
Cold Plasma Application: Using a Cold Plasma device or facial treatment, apply the cold plasma to the skin. This process is painless, and you will typically feel a cool sensation.
Post-Treatment Care: After the treatment, apply a gentle moisturizer and sunscreen. If using at home, follow the device instructions for the recommended frequency and usage.

Active Ingredients
Ionized Gas (Plasma): The primary component in Cold Plasma treatment, which is electrically charged and helps to stimulate the skin at a cellular level.
Hyaluronic Acid: Often paired with Cold Plasma, this ingredient helps to deeply hydrate the skin and plump the complexion.
Peptides: Assist in stimulating collagen production, improving skin strength and elasticity.
Vitamin C & E: Provide antioxidant protection and help to brighten the skin.

Skin Type
Cold Plasma is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin, due to its gentle yet effective nature. It is particularly beneficial for individuals with: Aging skin (fine lines, wrinkles), Dull, uneven skin tone Dry or dehydrated skin, Sensitive or irritated skin

13f068a6-c606-4e5b-bc26-7e2c047b6e39.name: Collagen Boosting Microneedling  Facial
13f068a6-c606-4e5b-bc26-7e2c047b6e39.description:
Short Description
The Collagen Boosting Microneedling Facial uses tiny needles to create controlled micro-injuries in the skin, stimulating collagen production. This non-invasive treatment improves skin texture, reduces fine lines and acne scars, and enhances skin elasticity, leaving you with smoother, firmer, and more youthful-looking skin.

What It Does & Benefits
Collagen Boosting Microneedling Facial stimulates collagen production by creating tiny controlled micro-injuries in the skin. This process promotes natural healing, improving skin texture, tone, and elasticity. The treatment targets fine lines, wrinkles, acne scars, hyperpigmentation, and enlarged pores, leaving skin smoother, firmer, and more youthful.

Instructions
Cleanse the skin thoroughly before starting the procedure.
Apply a numbing cream to minimize discomfort during the treatment.
Use a microneedling device with fine needles to create micro-injuries in the skin’s surface.
Apply a serum or treatment to further enhance the healing process and promote collagen production.
After the session, allow the skin to recover naturally.
Post-Treatment Care:
Avoid sun exposure for 48 hours and always apply sunscreen.
Refrain from using harsh skincare products (such as retinol) for a few days.
Keep the skin hydrated and avoid touching or picking at the treated area.
Expect mild redness or swelling, which typically subsides within a few hours to a day.

Active Ingredients
Hyaluronic Acid: For deep hydration.
Vitamin C: For brightening and antioxidant protection.
Peptides: To support collagen and elastin production.

Skin Type
None

Hyaluronic Acid: For deep hydration and plumping effects.

13f068a6-c606-4e5b-bc26-7e2c047b6e39.name: Restylane Kysse

13f068a6-c606-4e5b-bc26-7e2c047b6e39.name: Restylane Lyft

13f068a6-c606-4e5b-bc26-7e2c047b6e39.name: Restylane Refyne

13f068a6-c606-4e5b-bc26-7e2c047b6e39.name: RF Fractional - Face & Neck
13f068a6-c606-4e5b-bc26-7e2c047b6e39.description:

Minimal Downtime: Most people experience little to no downtime, with the possibility of mild redness or swelling that typically resolves within a few hours to a day.

Pre-Treatment: Cleanse the skin to remove makeup, oils, and impurities.
Treatment: A numbing cream may be applied to the face and neck to ensure comfort. RF Fractional energy is then delivered to the targeted areas using a handheld device.
The RF energy penetrates the skin, stimulating collagen production and tightening skin for a smoother, more youthful appearance.
Post-Treatment: Some mild redness or swelling may occur but typically subsides within a few hours. Cooling gels or soothing creams are often applied to calm the skin.
You can usually resume your regular activities after the procedure, though it's advisable to avoid direct sun exposure for a few days.

Radiofrequency (RF) Energy: The primary active agent that stimulates collagen and elastin production within the deeper layers of the skin.

13f068a6-c606-4e5b-bc26-7e2c047b6e39.name: RF Microneedling - Eyes
13f068a6-c606-4e5b-bc26-7e2c047b6e39.description:

Short Description
The UF Double Chin treatment uses advanced high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) technology to target and reduce fat in the chin area, helping to sculpt and tighten the skin. This non-invasive procedure stimulates collagen production, improves skin elasticity, and addresses the appearance of a double chin, resulting in a more defined jawline and a youthful, contoured profile.

What It Does & Benefits
The UF Double Chin treatment focuses ultrasound energy on the fat cells under the chin to promote fat reduction and skin tightening. The benefits include:  
- Fat Reduction: Targets and reduces excess fat in the chin area for a slimmer, more defined jawline.  
- Skin Tightening & Lifting: Stimulates collagen and elastin production, tightening the skin and reducing sagging in the neck and chin area.  
- Non-Surgical Solution: Provides a non-invasive alternative to liposuction or other surgical procedures for reducing a double chin.  
- Improved Jawline Definition: Contours the chin and jawline, providing a more sculpted and youthful appearance.  
- Minimal Downtime: The treatment requires no downtime, allowing you to return to your daily activities immediately after the procedure.  
- Gradual & Natural Results: Results continue to improve over time as collagen production is stimulated, leading to a more defined and youthful chin area.

Instructions 
1. Pre-Treatment: The treatment area is cleansed to remove oils, dirt, and makeup. A topical numbing cream may be applied to ensure comfort during the procedure.  
2. Treatment: The UF Double Chin device is used to deliver focused ultrasound energy to the subcutaneous fat layers beneath the chin. The ultrasound waves target fat cells, causing them to break down and be naturally eliminated by the body. The procedure usually lasts 30-45 minutes depending on the area treated.  
3. Post-Treatment: Some mild redness, swelling, or tenderness in the treated area may occur but typically resolves within a few hours to a day.  
4. Post-Care: Avoid direct sun exposure and apply sunscreen to protect the treated area. Drink plenty of water to help the body naturally eliminate fat cells, and refrain from intense exercise for 24-48 hours after the procedure.

Active Ingredients  
- High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound (HIFU): Delivers precise ultrasound energy that targets fat cells and stimulates collagen production, leading to skin tightening and fat reduction.

Skin Type  
The UF Double Chin treatment is suitable for most skin types, especially those with mild to moderate skin laxity and a double chin. It is ideal for individuals seeking a non-invasive option to reduce chin fat and enhance jawline definition. Those with more severe skin laxity or extensive fat deposits may require additional treatments or consider other options.

a1035583-2fe1-40f9-b4ae-3bb4722f3fe1.name: Restylane Kysse

a1035583-2fe1-40f9-b4ae-3bb4722f3fe1.name: RF Fractional - Face & Neck
a1035583-2fe1-40f9-b4ae-3bb4722f3fe1.description:
